text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spotted Silence Suzuka talking to
Air Groove and a student who seemed to be their junior.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong?
Is there a problem?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well... yes. I promised to oversee our junior's practice today,
but... urgent student council business came up.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
A-Ah, n-no! I'll be completely fine on my own!
I'll just work through my usual routine!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...What kind of practice do you usually do?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Right now, aiming for my target race,
I've been studying training theory while focusing on form
correction and stamina building!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
To make sure I win, I thought I absolutely had to
completely fix all my current flaws! So—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
............
—Um, are you running to win races?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry.
I was just, well, curious.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... O-Of course! 
Now that I've been accepted into Tracen Academy,
getting results should come first, right...?!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
My times have improved compared to before too...
And... um...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Um. If it's alright with you...
would you mind if I took Air Groove's place?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What? Suzuka... you will?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—No. Heh... Interesting.
In that case, let us take you up on your kind offer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's get started right away.
Today's practice will be...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...To catch up to me.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
............
...Huuuh?!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...! Sh-she's way too fast...!
Th-this has nothing to do with theory or
pacing anymore...!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: I-I can't take it anymore~~...!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
S-Suzuka-san...?
Wh-why do you look so completely relaxed...?!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
............Dammit!
I can't let it end like this!
I can still keep going too!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*――Wait, what?!
Suzuka-san, where are you going?!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...Argh, at this point, anywhere is fine!
Either way, just run, run, run...
I'm gonna run as hard as I can~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Silence Suzuka, the junior eventually dashed
right out of the academy. In her reckless, all-out sprint,
there was not a shred of theory left, but――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――strangely enough, she looked like she was having fun.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
――You've finally returned, have you?
I was starting to worry where on earth you went.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...And yet, what happened here?
Both of you look remarkably refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...How was it?
When you were running earlier――
the "view" you saw.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Th-the view? Um...
Well, partway through, I didn't even have
the leeway to think about anything extra――

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...It felt amazing.
It was just pure, simple fun to run――

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I see. That's good. Then it seems I was able
to teach you what I wanted to convey...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I've run in many races, but... in the end,
that's the only thing I truly want
to pass on to someone...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... It sounded like a rather rough way of teaching.
Very well. That too is just like you, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Stepping forward on your own to guide juniors, eh. Heh...
You've changed as well――
